description: Filaire cyclable - CA Saint-Quentin-en-Yvelines is a dataset listed in Datasqy open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Saint-Quentin-en-Yvelines. Cette donnée représente les aménagements cyclables aménagés sur le territoire pour encourager la mobilité douce. Informations générales de la classe d'entité Origine ou Source: SQY Date de construction: 2013 Actualité: Août 2022 Précision: Système de référence: RGF93 - CC49 (EPSG 3949) Contact: opendata@sqy.fr Exhaustivité géographique: SQY et ses environs. Coverage: Saint-Quentin-en-Yvelines. The portal files it under Transports, Déplacements. Its keywords are déplacement, vélo, aménagement cyclable, mobilité douce. The portal shows 3,714 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2025-08-20 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-sqy-fr-portal.
